run_single_gpu_test: run a single GPU test on a 3D detection model with a PyTorch data loader
test_model_with_visualization: test a model on a single GPU and save visualization results to an output directory
run_inference_no_grad: run inference on a model using torch.no_grad to collect prediction results from a dataset
review_single_gpu_test: review the single_gpu_test function that evaluates a model and returns a list of prediction results
refactor_single_gpu_test: refactor the single_gpu_test function to support multi-GPU testing or custom result formatting
